svg.text: Forge Wizard Pipeline — Agent Flow & Data Dependencies
Example: Conveyor Transfer System (1 motor, 2 PE sensors, E-Stop, 2 pushbuttons)

g.text: devices: [{name:"M01", type:"Motor DOL"}, {name:"PE01", type:"PE Sensor"}, {name:"PE02", type:"PE Sensor"}, {name:"ESTOP", type:"Safety"}]
Gaps filled, devices confirmed, sequences detailed
PM: "How many PE sensors at each end? What triggers the transfer — operator button or automatic?"
Engineer: "1 PE sensor each end. PB_START triggers. Bi-directional — direction based on which PE is active."
STEPS 3-4: Project Setup + Hardware & IO (Engineer-driven, no AI)
DI: ESTOP_OK, PE01_DET, PE02_DET, M01_OL, PB_START, PB_STOP
Devices: M01(Motor DOL), PE01, PE02, ESTOP, PB_START, PB_STOP
STEP 5: Device FB Generation (1 AI call per device)
Matches FB templates or generates from scratch
VAR_INPUT: enable, fwdCmd, revCmd, resetAlarms | VAR_OUTPUT: fwdrun, revrun, overload, busy, error, status:Word
STEP 6: Linkage Matrix Generation + Engineer Review
Maps FB params to global DBs
linkage_matrix saved to session — SINGLE SOURCE OF TRUTH for all subsequent code generation
deviceLinkage[].wiring[] (exact param-to-DB field mapping) | processSequences[].rows[] (step flow) | safetyConditions[] | permissives[]
Example wiring: InstM01.fwdCmd reads "ProcessCommands".m01CmdFwd | InstM01.fwdrun writes "HmiData".motor01FwdRun
STEP 7: Device Code (Call FCs, IO Linking, Global DBs)
Call FCs + IO Linking + Global DBs
+ MotorCall (FC), SensorCall (FC), IoLinking (FC), HmiData (DB), ProcessCommands (DB), Configuration (DB)
STEP 8: Process Code Generation (the main event)
1. Derive fault spec from matrix safetyConditions[] + fault_exit rows + device types
2. Pre-compute step/action DB names | 3. Build filtered tag dictionary per sequence from device artifacts
Tag dict: only tags for devices used in THIS sequence (from matrix rows[].devices)
Receives: matrix steps, permissives, safety conditions
NO fault logic (separate FC handles that)
Deterministic — no AI, exact field names
Latching circuits: (FaultCond OR "DB_Faults".Fxxx) AND NOT reset
Review + Fix pipeline (SCL artifacts only — LAD skipped)
Standards Reviewer checks SCL → Code Architect rewrites if needed → TIA Bridge compile → auto-fix loop
Sequence FBs (LAD) + Fault FC (LAD) + Step/Action DBs (SCL) + DB_Faults (SCL) + Main (SCL)
Overview screen, Motor faceplate, Diagnostics screen
1. Import SCL (topological sort: UDTs → FBs → DBs → OBs)
Result: TIA Portal project with all PLC blocks + HMI screens compiled and ready for download to PLC
Compile errors auto-fixed via Pattern Librarian → corrections saved for future generations
CROSS-CUTTING: Pattern Learning (feeds back into all future generations)
When a compile fix succeeds, Pattern Librarian AI
analyzes before/after diff → saves APPROVED pattern
Device FBs, Call FCs, Process Code, Compile Fix
DATA FLOW SUMMARY — What feeds what
→ Q&A → devices, sequences → Matrix → device wiring, process steps
→ FB interfaces + global DB schemas → tag dictionary → process code (exact field names)
→ device wiring (param→DB field) + process sequences (steps, faults) → process code + fault FC
→ naming conventions, process rules (step/action pattern), FB rules → ALL generation prompts
→ learned corrections from compile fixes → injected as WRONG/CORRECT examples in ALL prompts
→ parsed from device artifacts + matrix wiring → filtered per sequence → prevents AI inventing tags
